context: A weekend morning at the apartment building park. Sho has been trying to ride a scooter; Riku is sitting on a bench with headphones in. He notices and sets the headphones down.
purpose: older-kid energy directed at a smaller one — accidental big-brother

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おい、そこ、止まんなって。
lines.style: Sharp initial call with a half-laugh underneath. Quick Tokyo teen bark, almost teasing. Warm enough to catch rather than scare.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A real held beat of surprise. Caught mid-motion, eyes lifting. Quiet attentiveness — no resistance, just noticing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 足、こう置くんだよ。本当に。
lines.en: Your feet — place them like this. For real.
lines.style: Crouches down, demonstrating on his own foot. Voice shifts to patient instruction. Clear, unhurried, almost intimate in its focus.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tentative, concentrating. Small breath before speaking. Voice carries the full weight of trying — careful, precise, seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、そう。…見て、楽になる。
lines.en: Yeah — exactly. Watch — it gets easier.
lines.style: Affirming and encouraging. Voice less guarded than usual, warmer at the edges. Gentle conviction, like he's genuinely pleased.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, genuine relief breaking through. Voice lights up with the small discovery. Unguarded joy, the kind that's not performed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 俺も、お前くらいの時、ヘタやった。
lines.en: I was terrible at it too when I was about your age.
lines.style: Unexpectedly vulnerable share. Voice softens, becomes more real. A quiet admission that costs him a little. Slower pace, like he's deciding to say it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small awestruck question, genuinely surprised. Voice carries real wonder — not performing, just noticing that this older person was once uncertain too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 本当に。…じゃ、もう一回、見せて。
lines.style: Gentle redirect, activating the older-brother voice. Still warm, but now with quiet authority. A small nod forward — expectant but not harsh.
